content:
Just moments after reporting the AirPods Pro 3 hitting one of its lowest prices ever, the floodgates of fall Prime Day deals have opened across Apple's latest Mac lineup. The entire Mac mini range powered by the M6 chip is now at new lows with up to nearly $150 off, while the 2026 Mac Studio is seeing discounts of close to $200.

Beyond those offers, essentially every M5 MacBook Air configuration is now $200 off, the M5 Pro MacBook Pro continues to see $500 discounts, and Apple's brand new minimalist full-character design Magic Keyboard is seeing its first discount yet, while the Magic Mouse is also on sale for a rare markdown.

Readers looking to score a MacBook will want to take note, as fall Prime Day has brought the lowest prices we've seen in months across the Apple M5 MacBook Air lineup. Amazon is now offering solid $200 discounts on essentially every configuration, with most models also available in multiple colors:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (orig. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,399 (orig. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (orig. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (orig. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,599 (orig. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (orig. $1,999)

Amazon this morning brought a collection of pretty notable price drops across Apple's new Mac mini lineup. From the entry-level M6 configurations all the way up to the high-end M5 Max models, we're now tracking up to $149 in savings marking new all-time low prices:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (orig. $899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (orig. $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (orig. $1,699) — all-time low

Beyond those offers, the new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM is also hitting an all-time low with Amazon cutting the pricing by a massive $199, making this the best offer since it launched last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (orig. $2,499) — all-time low

While we're still waiting (and hoping) for more widespread MacBook Pro discounts, Amazon still has a surprising $500 price drop on this upgraded 2TB configuration — a deal that lands it $100 below its previous MSRP before the price increase:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (orig. $3,199)

On top of all that, we're also tracking a host of great deals across Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, the Magic Mouse in both black and white is on sale for a rare markdown of up to nearly 25% off list, while Apple's recently-released new Magic Keyboard with its clean full-character key treatment is seeing its very first discount:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (new 2026 model) $80 (orig. $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse White $60 (orig. $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse Black $80 (orig. $99)
